# tenant-quota

> Per-tenant usage quotas over fixed UTC calendar windows: plan limits with per-tenant overrides, atomic check-and-consume through a `CounterStore` port, reservations, soft-limit events and reset times. Distribution `trysac-tenant-quota`, import name `tenant_quota`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
